name: confirm-dialog
title: Confirm dialog
description: Confirmation on the native dialog: both buttons name the action, the safe one has focus, red only when something is destroyed, optional type-to-confirm.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new open state when the dialog closes, by cancel, Escape or a click outside.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the dialog, also its accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: Text under the heading; it also describes the dialog.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The verb and the thing, e.g. “Delete project”. Never “Yes” or “OK”.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: What happens if they back out, e.g. “Keep project”. Never “No” or “Cancel” alone.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called when the confirm button is pressed, before the dialog closes.

props.name: destructive
props.description: Red, for actions that destroy something. Leave it off for everything else.

props.name: typeToConfirm
props.description: When set, the confirm button stays off until this exact text is typed, e.g. the project name.

a11y.text: It is a native modal dialog, so focus is trapped and Esc closes it. Focus goes to the safe cancel button on open, so a habitual Enter keeps the data. With typeToConfirm, the confirm button stays disabled until the exact text is typed. Enter in that field submits once it is right.

The dialog is labelled by the title and described by the description when there is one. The type-to-confirm field has a real label that shows the text to type. The two buttons take their text from confirmLabel and cancelLabel.
Under reduced motion the opening transition is off.
